Cmax 1154.7 ng/mL → unbound fraction 0.5% applied: 5.77 ng/mL

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.4. 독성에 관한 자료.4.3. 독성에 대한 심사자 의견[11]
segments.ko_txt: 랫드 수태능시험에서 JTZ-951은 암수 수태능에 영향을 미치지 않았으나, 초기배 발생에 영향(배태자 사망률 증가)을 미쳐 NOAEL은 3mg/kg로 결정됨.
segments.en_txt: In a rat fertility study, JTZ-951 did not affect male or female fertility; however, it affected early embryonic development (increased embryofetal mortality), and the NOAEL was determined to be 3mg/kg.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.4. 독성에 관한 자료.4.3. 독성에 대한 심사자 의견[12]
segments.ko_txt: 랫드 및 토끼의 배태자 발생시험에서 기형 유발의 증거는 없었으나, 랫드 및 토끼에서 배태자 사망률 증가, 태자수 감소가 나타나 NOAEL은 각각 10 및 60mg/kg로 결정됨.
segments.en_txt: In embryo-fetal development studies in rats and rabbits, there was no evidence of teratogenicity; however, increased embryofetal mortality and decreased number of fetuses were observed in rats and rabbits, and the NOAELs were determined to be 10 and 60mg/kg, respectively.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.4. 독성에 관한 자료.4.3. 독성에 대한 심사자 의견[13]
segments.ko_txt: 랫드 출생전후 발달독성시험 10mg/kg에서 출생자의 발육지연이 관찰되어 발생 NOAEL은 3mg/kg로, F1 세대의 세대 암수 랫드 행동발달 및 생식에 대한 NOAEL은 >10mg/kg로 결정됨.
segments.en_txt: In a rat pre- and postnatal development toxicity study, delayed development of offspring was observed at 10mg/kg; therefore, the developmental NOAEL was determined to be 3mg/kg, and the NOAEL for behavioral development and reproduction of male and female F1 generation rats was determined to be >10mg/kg.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.4. 독성에 관한 자료.4.3. 독성에 대한 심사자 의견[14]
segments.ko_txt: 랫드 배태자 및 출생전후 발생시험에서 관찰된 태자 발생독성 관련 NOAEL 노출 대비 신청최고 용량 임상 노출에 대한 안전역이 좁음(AUC 기준 0.7배, Cmax 기준 1.6배).
segments.en_txt: The safety margin of clinical exposure at the maximum proposed dose relative to NOAEL exposure for fetal developmental toxicity observed in rat embryo-fetal and pre-/postnatal development studies is narrow (0.7-fold based on AUC, 1.6-fold based on Cmax).

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.4. 독성에 관한 자료.4.3. 독성에 대한 심사자 의견[15]
segments.ko_txt: (→ADME 분포 항)랫드 출생전·후 발생 및 모체기능시험에서 시험물질 및 그 대사체가 모유로 이행되는 것이 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: (→ADME Distribution section) In a rat pre-/postnatal development and maternal function study, transfer of the test substance and its metabolites into milk was confirmed.

segments.ko_txt: 신성 빈혈의 주요한 원인은 신장 내 세포의 EPO 생산이 신기능 저하와 함께 감소되어 발생하는 것으로 말기 신부전 환자의 주요 합병증의 하나임.
segments.en_txt: A major cause of renal anemia is a decrease in EPO production by cells in the kidney accompanying deterioration of renal function, and it is one of the major complications in patients with end-stage renal failure.

segments.ko_txt: 조직 중의 산소가 충분한 상태에서는 HIF-PH에 의해 HIF-α의 프롤린 잔기가 hydroxylation되고, 저산소 상태에서는 HIF-PH에 의한 HIF-α의 hydroxylation이 억제되고 그 결과 HIF-α가 안정화되어 저산소 반응이 유도됨.
segments.en_txt: Under conditions of sufficient oxygen in tissues, proline residues of HIF-α are hydroxylated by HIF-PH; under hypoxic conditions, hydroxylation of HIF-α by HIF-PH is inhibited, and as a result HIF-α is stabilized and hypoxic responses are induced.

segments.ko_txt: 이때 안정화된 HIF에 의해 발현이 제어되는 단백질로는 조혈인자인 EPO, 철대사와 관련된 헵시딘, VEGF 등이 알려져 있음.
segments.en_txt: Proteins whose expression is regulated by stabilized HIF are known to include the hematopoietic factor EPO, hepcidin related to iron metabolism, and VEGF.

segments.ko_txt: 에나로두스타트(enarodustat, JTZ-951)는 HIF-PH 저해제로서, 신성빈혈 치료제로 개발된 신약임.
segments.en_txt: Enarodustat (enarodustat, JTZ-951) is a HIF-PH inhibitor and is a new drug developed for the treatment of renal anemia.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 HIF-PH에 대한 저해작용을 세포를 이용하여 HIF 발현 및 EPO 생성에 대한 영향을 평가하였으며, 동물을 이용하여 간 및 신장의 EPO mRNA 량, 혈장 중 EPO 농도 측정을 통해 확인함.
segments.en_txt: The inhibitory effect of JTZ-951 on HIF-PH was evaluated in cells by assessing effects on HIF expression and EPO production, and was confirmed in animals by measuring hepatic and renal EPO mRNA levels and plasma EPO concentrations.

segments.ko_txt: 신성빈혈모델 및 정상 동물을 이용하여 적혈구 조혈 및 철 이용에 대한 영향을 평가한 결과 JTZ-951은 철 이용능을 저하시키지 않으면서 적혈구 조혈 항진작용을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: Evaluation of effects on erythropoiesis and iron utilization using a renal anemia model and normal animals showed that JTZ-951 exerts an erythropoiesis-stimulating effect without reducing iron utilization capacity.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.1. 생체 외 시험[0]
segments.ko_txt: 재조합 인간 HIF-PH1, HIF-PH2, HIF-PH3 정제 효소, 기질 HIF 펩타이드 및 α-케토글루타르산을 이용하여 JTZ-951의 효과를 평가한 결과, Ki값 0.016, 0.061, 0.101μmol/L로 JTZ-951는 HIF-PH의 저해제임을 확인함.
segments.en_txt: Evaluation of the effect of JTZ-951 using recombinant human HIF-PH1, HIF-PH2, and HIF-PH3 purified enzymes, the substrate HIF peptide, and α-ketoglutarate showed Ki values of 0.016, 0.061, and 0.101μmol/L, confirming that JTZ-951 is an inhibitor of HIF-PH.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.1. 생체 외 시험[1]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 주요 인간 대사체인 (R)-M2에 대하여 HIF-PH의 저해 활성을 평가한 결과, JTZ-951과 유사한 수준으로 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: When inhibitory activity of HIF-PH was evaluated for (R)-M2, the major human metabolite of JTZ-951, it was observed at a level similar to that of JTZ-951.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.1. 생체 외 시험[2]
segments.ko_txt: Hep3B 세포를 이용하여 HIF 발현에 대한 JTZ-951의 효과를 평가한 결과, 약물 처리 1시간 후부터 HIF-1α 및 HIF-2α 발현량을 증가시켰으며, HIF-1β의 발현량에는 변화가 없었음.
segments.en_txt: When the effect of JTZ-951 on HIF expression was evaluated using Hep3B cells, it increased expression levels of HIF-1α and HIF-2α starting 1 hour after drug treatment, with no change in expression levels of HIF-1β.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.1. 생체 외 시험[3]
segments.ko_txt: Hep3B 세포를 이용하여 EPO 생성에 대한 JTZ-951(0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10μmol/L)의 효과를 정상 산소 및 저산소 상태에서 평가한 결과, 저산소 상태의 EPO 생성을 100%로 한 경우 EC50 값은 4.7μmol/L임.
segments.en_txt: When the effect of JTZ-951 (0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10μmol/L) on EPO production was evaluated using Hep3B cells under normoxic and hypoxic conditions, with EPO production under hypoxic conditions set as 100%, the EC50 value was 4.7μmol/L.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.1. 생체 외 시험[4]
segments.ko_txt: Hep3B 세포를 이용하여 EPO 생성에 대한 대사체 (R)-M2(0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3mmol/L)의 효과를 정상 산소 및 저산소 상태에서 평가한 결과, 저산소 상태의 EPO 생성을 100%로 한 경우 EC50 값은 100μmol/L 보다 크게 나타나, 대사체 (R)-M2는 JTZ-951 보다 효과가 약하게 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: When the effect of the metabolite (R)-M2 (0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3mmol/L) on EPO production was evaluated using Hep3B cells under normoxic and hypoxic conditions, with EPO production under hypoxic conditions set as 100%, the EC50 value was greater than 100μmol/L, indicating that the metabolite (R)-M2 has weaker effects than JTZ-951.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.1 EPO 생성에 대한 작용[0]
segments.ko_txt: 정상 랫드를 이용하여 간 및 신장 내 EPO mRNA 양에 대한 JTZ-951(0.3, 1, 3mg/kg)의 효과를 평가한 결과, 1mg/kg부터 용량 의존적으로 간 및 신장 내 EPO mRNA 양을 유의하게 증가시켰으며, 4시간째까지 증가한 후 투여 24시간째에는 부형제군과 동등 수준으로 감소함.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effect of JTZ-951 (0.3, 1, 3mg/kg) on the amount of EPO mRNA in the liver and kidney in normal rats, JTZ-951 significantly increased the amount of EPO mRNA in the liver and kidney in a dose-dependent manner starting from 1mg/kg; the increase was observed up to 4 hours, and then decreased to a level comparable to the vehicle group at 24 hours after dosing.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.1 EPO 생성에 대한 작용[1]
segments.ko_txt: 신성빈혈 동물 모델(5/6신장 적출 랫드)을 이용하여 혈장 내 EPO 농도에 대한 JTZ-951(0.3, 1, 3mg/kg)의 효과를 평가한 결과, 3mg/kg에서 혈장 내 EPO 농도를 유의하게 증가시켰으며 8시간째까지 상승한 후 투여 24시간째에는 부형제군과 동등 수준으로 감소함.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effect of JTZ-951 (0.3, 1, 3mg/kg) on plasma EPO concentrations using a renal anemia animal model (5/6 nephrectomized rats), JTZ-951 significantly increased plasma EPO concentrations at 3mg/kg; levels rose up to 8 hours and then decreased to a level comparable to the vehicle group at 24 hours after dosing.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.2 적혈구 조혈에 대한 작용[0]
segments.ko_txt: 신성빈혈 동물 모델(5/6신장 적출 랫드)을 이용하여 JTZ-951(0.3, 1, 3mg/kg) 반복투여시 적혈구 조혈에 대한 작용을 평가한 결과, 부형제군의 Hb 농도는 Sham 처치군과 비교하여 유의하게 낮은 값을 나타내었으며, JTZ-951 반복투여에 의하여 1mg/kg부터 용량 의존적으로 Hb 농도를 유의하게 증가시킴.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effect on erythropoiesis upon repeated administration of JTZ-951 (0.3, 1, 3mg/kg) using a renal anemia animal model (5/6 nephrectomized rats), the Hb concentration in the vehicle group was significantly lower than that in the sham-operated group, and repeated administration of JTZ-951 significantly increased Hb concentration in a dose-dependent manner starting from 1mg/kg.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.3 철 이용에 대한 작용[0]
segments.ko_txt: 정상 랫드를 이용하여 JTZ-951(3mg/kg) 반복투여시(42일) 철 매개변수에 대한 작용을 rHuEPO (50IU/kg, 피하)와 비교 검토한 결과, JTZ-951은 rHuEPO와 유사한 정도로 Hb 농도를 상승시킴.
segments.en_txt: As a result of comparative evaluation of the effects on iron parameters during repeated administration of JTZ-951 (3mg/kg) (42 days) in normal rats versus rHuEPO (50IU/kg, subcutaneous), JTZ-951 increased Hb concentration to a similar extent as rHuEPO.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.3 철 이용에 대한 작용[1]
segments.ko_txt: rHuEPO의 경우 철 이용 지표로 사용되는 TSAT(Transferrin saturation) 및 혈청 철농도를 유의하게 저하시켰지만, JTZ-951은 그렇지 않았으며 이는 간 내 비햄철 함량 측정에서도 유사한 결과를 나타냄으로써 JTZ-951은 철 이용능을 저하시키지 않으면서 적혈구 조혈 항진작용을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: Whereas rHuEPO significantly decreased TSAT (transferrin saturation) and serum iron concentration, which are used as indices of iron utilization, JTZ-951 did not; similar findings were observed in the measurement of non-heme iron content in the liver, indicating that JTZ-951 exerts an erythropoiesis-stimulating effect without decreasing iron utilization capacity.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.2.2.3 철 이용에 대한 작용[2]
segments.ko_txt: 정상 랫드를 이용하여 간 내 헵시딘 mRNA 양에 대한 JTZ-951(3mg/kg)의 영향을 rHuEPO (50IU/kg, 피하)와 비교 평가한 결과, JTZ-951은 간 내 헵시딘의 mRNA 양을 유의하게 감소시켰으나, rHuEPO는 감소시키지 않음.
segments.en_txt: As a result of comparatively evaluating the effect of JTZ-951 (3mg/kg) on the amount of hepcidin mRNA in the liver in normal rats versus rHuEPO (50IU/kg, subcutaneous), JTZ-951 significantly decreased the amount of hepatic hepcidin mRNA, whereas rHuEPO did not decrease it.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 비특이적 작용을 평가하기 위하여, 23종의 수용체 및 5종의 효소에 대한 영향을 평가한 결과, IC50 값 은 모두 10μmol/L 보다 크게 나타남.
segments.en_txt: To evaluate non-specific effects of JTZ-951, impacts on 23 receptors and 5 enzymes were assessed, and all IC50 values were greater than 10μmol/L.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951는 랫드를 이용한 심혈관계에 대한 영향 평가 30mg/kg에서 수축기 혈압 저하 및 심박수 증가가 관 찰되었으며, 중추신경계 및 호흡기계에는 어떠한 영향도 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: In an evaluation of effects on the cardiovascular system in rats, a decrease in systolic blood pressure and an increase in heart rate were observed at 30mg/kg, and no effects were observed on the central nervous system or respiratory system.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.3.1 중추신경계에 대한 영향[0]
segments.ko_txt: 수컷 랫드를 이용하여 JTZ-951(3, 10, 30mg/kg, 단회)의 어윈시험을 수행한 결과, JTZ-951은 일반 증상 및 행 동에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: As a result of performing an Irwin test in male rats with a single dose of JTZ-951 (3, 10, 30mg/kg), JTZ-951 did not affect general signs or behavior.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.3.2 심혈관계에 대한 영향[0]
segments.ko_txt: hERG HEK293 세포를 이용하여 JTZ-951(10, 30, 100μmol/L)이 hERG 전류에 미치는 영향을 평가한 결과, 어떤 농도에서도 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 양성 대조군 E-4031은 0.1μmol/L에서 hERG 전류를 92.2% 저해함.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effect of JTZ-951 (10, 30, 100μmol/L) on hERG current using hERG HEK293 cells, no effect was observed at any concentration, whereas the positive control E-4031 inhibited hERG current by 92.2% at 0.1μmol/L.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.3.2 심혈관계에 대한 영향[1]
segments.ko_txt: 수컷 비글견을 이용하여 무마취 상태에서 JTZ-951(1, 3, 10mg/kg)의 영향을 평가한 결과, 어떤 용량군에서도 혈압, 심박수 및 심전도에 영향을 미치지 않음.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effects of JTZ-951 (1, 3, 10mg/kg) in conscious male beagle dogs, JTZ-951 did not affect blood pressure, heart rate, or electrocardiogram in any dose group.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.3.2 심혈관계에 대한 영향[2]
segments.ko_txt: 수컷 랫드를 이용하여 무마취 상태에서 비관혈법(non-blood method)으로 JTZ-951(3, 10, 30mg/kg)의 영향을 평가한 결과, 30mg/kg에서 투여 4 및 8시간째 수축기 혈압을 저하시키고 심박수를 증가시켰으며 투여 24시간째에는 소실됨.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effects of JTZ-951 (3, 10, 30mg/kg) in conscious male rats by a non-invasive method (non-blood method), JTZ-951 decreased systolic blood pressure and increased heart rate at 30mg/kg at 4 and 8 hours post-dose, and these effects disappeared at 24 hours post-dose.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.3.3 호흡기계에 대한 영향[0]
segments.ko_txt: 수컷 비글견 대상으로 무마취 상태에서 WBP(whole body plethysmograph) 방법으로 JTZ-951(1, 3, 10mg/kg, 용량증량)의 영향을 평가한 결과, 어떤 용량에서도 호흡수, 1회 환기량 및 분당 호흡량에 영향을 미치 지 않음.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the effects of JTZ-951 (1, 3, 10mg/kg, dose escalation) in conscious male beagle dogs using the WBP (whole body plethysmograph) method, JTZ-951 did not affect respiratory rate, tidal volume, or minute ventilation at any dose.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4. 흡수․분포․대사․배설에 관한 시험[0]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951는 경구 생체이용률이 우수하며, 경구투여 후 주로 소변과 변으로 배설되고, 식이에 의해 노출이 감소됨. JTZ-951는 CYP2C8, 2C9 및 3A4에 의해 대사되어 M2가 형성됨.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 has good oral bioavailability, is mainly excreted in urine and feces after oral administration, and exposure is decreased by food. JTZ-951 is metabolized by CYP2C8, 2C9, and 3A4 to form M2.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4. 흡수․분포․대사․배설에 관한 시험[1]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951는 CYP 효소를 저해하거나 유도하지 않으나, BCRP의 기질이며, OAT1 및 OAT3의 억제제로 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 does not inhibit or induce CYP enzymes; however, it is a substrate of BCRP and has been identified as an inhibitor of OAT1 and OAT3.

segments.ko_txt: 랫드, 개 및 원숭이에 JTZ-951 또는 방사능 표지된 14C-JTZ-951을 경구(1mg/kg) 또는 정맥내(0.3mg/kg) 투여 후 JTZ-951의 생체이용률을 산출하였으며, 각각 74.5, 39.4 및 41.7%로 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: After oral (1mg/kg) or intravenous (0.3mg/kg) administration of JTZ-951 or radiolabeled 14C-JTZ-951 to rats, dogs, and monkeys, the bioavailability of JTZ-951 was calculated and confirmed to be 74.5, 39.4, and 41.7%, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951(0.3, 1, 3mg/kg)을 비금식 랫드 및 금식 개에 경구투여한 결과, 랫드에서 Cmax 및 AUC0-8은 용량 비례성이상으로 증가하였으며, 개에서는 용량 비례성에 따라 증가함.
segments.en_txt: As a result of oral administration of JTZ-951 (0.3, 1, 3mg/kg) to non-fasted rats and fasted dogs, Cmax and AUC0-8 in rats increased more than dose-proportionally, whereas in dogs they increased dose-proportionally.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951(1, 3, 30mg/kg)을 금식 원숭이에 경구투여한 결과, Cmax 및 AUCinf은 용량 비례성 이상으로 증가함.
segments.en_txt: As a result of oral administration of JTZ-951 (1, 3, 30mg/kg) to fasted monkeys, Cmax and AUCinf increased more than dose-proportionally.

segments.ko_txt: 식이영향 평가를 위하여 랫드 및 개에 JTZ-951를 투여한 후 약동학을 분석한 결과, 두 종 모두에서 Cmax 및 AUCinf가 모두 금식군에서 높게 나타남.
segments.en_txt: To evaluate food effects, pharmacokinetics were analyzed after administration of JTZ-951 to rats and dogs, and in both species Cmax and AUCinf were higher in the fasted group.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951 반복투여독성시험의 독성동태 확인 결과, 마우스의 경우 모든 용량에서 JTZ-951 전신노출이 수컷보다 암컷에서 증가하였으나, 랫드, 개 및 원숭이의 경우 성차가 관찰되지 않음.
segments.en_txt: Based on toxicokinetic assessment in repeated-dose toxicity studies of JTZ-951, systemic exposure to JTZ-951 in mice was increased in females compared with males at all doses; however, no sex differences were observed in rats, dogs, or monkeys.

segments.ko_txt: 마우스 및 랫드의 경우 반복투여로 JTZ-951의 전신노출이 증가하는 것으로 나타났으나, 개 및 원숭이에서는 반복투여의 영향이 관찰되지 않음.
segments.en_txt: In mice and rats, systemic exposure to JTZ-951 increased with repeated administration; however, no effect of repeated administration was observed in dogs or monkeys.

segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg을 랫드에 경구투여 후, 맹장 및 대장을 제외한 각 조직에서 투여 1시간 후 최고 농도를 나타내었으며, 혈장보다 높은 노출은 나타낸 것은 소화관 외 신장 및 간이었고, 각각 혈장 대비 2.72 및 2.2배로 관찰됨(투여 168시간 후에 모든 조직에서 방사능은 5% 이하로 감소함).
segments.en_txt: After oral administration of 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg to rats, peak concentrations were observed at 1 hour post-dose in each tissue except the cecum and colon, and the only extra-gastrointestinal tissues showing higher exposure than plasma were kidney and liver, observed at 2.72- and 2.2-fold versus plasma, respectively (radioactivity decreased to 5% or less in all tissues at 168 hours post-dose).

segments.ko_txt: 개의 경우 투여 후 168시간째에 간, 신장, 부신, 정소 및 피부 등에서 방사능이 검출되었으며, 원숭이의 경우, 간, 신장, 피부, 정소상체 및 정낭 등의 조직에서 방사능이 검출됨.
segments.en_txt: In dogs, radioactivity was detected at 168 hours post-dose in liver, kidney, adrenal gland, testis, and skin, among others; in monkeys, radioactivity was detected in tissues including liver, kidney, skin, epididymis, and seminal vesicle.

segments.ko_txt: 평형투석법을 이용하여 JTZ-951(1~10μg/mL)의 혈장단백결합률을 평가한 결과, 마우스, 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 인간에서 각각 91.1%~92.2%, 98.3%~98.4%, 96.0%~96.7%, 99.0% 및 99.5%로 대체로 일정한 값을 보였지만, 100μg/mL 이상의 농도에서 포화 경향이 관찰되었고, 300μg/mL의 경우에는 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 인간에서 각각 94.6%, 91.3%, 97.7% 및 97.9%으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating plasma protein binding of JTZ-951 (1~10μg/mL) using equilibrium dialysis, relatively constant values were observed in mouse, rat, dog, monkey, and human of 91.1%~92.2%, 98.3%~98.4%, 96.0%~96.7%, 99.0%, and 99.5%, respectively; however, a saturation tendency was observed at concentrations of 100μg/mL or higher, and at 300μg/mL the values were 94.6%, 91.3%, 97.7%, and 97.9% in rat, dog, monkey, and human, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 인간 혈장단백결합에 있어 알부민이 주요 성분인 것으로 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: Albumin was confirmed to be the main component involved in human plasma protein binding of JTZ-951.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951 1~300μg/mL 농도 범위에서 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 인간의 혈구 이행률은 각각 1.8%~8.7%, 3.6%~18.8%, 1.7%~4.8% 및 2.5%~6.8%였으며, 또한 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 인간의 혈액/혈장 중 농도비는 각각 0.63~0.68, 0.52~0.61, 0.58~0.59 및 0.56~0.59로, 모든 동물 종에서 14C-JTZ-951의 혈구 이행률은 낮은 것으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: In the concentration range of JTZ-951 1~300μg/mL, the blood cell partitioning ratios in rat, dog, monkey, and human were 1.8%~8.7%, 3.6%~18.8%, 1.7%~4.8%, and 2.5%~6.8%, respectively; in addition, the blood/plasma concentration ratios in rat, dog, monkey, and human were 0.63~0.68, 0.52~0.61, 0.58~0.59, and 0.56~0.59, respectively, indicating low blood cell partitioning of 14C-JTZ-951 in all animal species.

segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg로 금식 상태의 임신 18일차 랫드에 경구투여 후 모체 및 태자의 조직 내 방사능을 측정한 결과, 태자 혈액에 투여 1시간 후에, 그 외의 조직에 투여 6시간 후 최고값을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: After oral administration of 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg to fasted pregnant rats on gestation day 18, radioactivity in maternal and fetal tissues was measured; peak values were observed at 1 hour post-dose in fetal blood and at 6 hours post-dose in other tissues.

segments.ko_txt: 모체 동물의 혈장 방사능 농도 대비 태자 조직의 방사능은 0.39배 이하임.
segments.en_txt: Radioactivity in fetal tissues was 0.39-fold or less relative to the maternal plasma radioactivity concentration.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[0]
segments.ko_txt: 건강한 성인 남성에게 JTZ-951 단회 경구투여 후 혈장 중 주성분은 JTZ-951이었으며, 대사체로는 M2 및 M5가 각각 1.0%~1.7% 및 0.6% 이하로 관찰되었으며, 두 대사체는 랫드 1개월 반복투여독성시험에서도 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: After single oral administration of JTZ-951 to healthy adult men, the major component in plasma was JTZ-951; the metabolites M2 and M5 were observed at 1.0%~1.7% and 0.6% or less, respectively, and both metabolites were also observed in a 1-month repeated-dose toxicity study in rats.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[1]
segments.ko_txt: 혈액투석 유지요법 환자에게 JTZ-951을 15일간 반복투여 후 1.5 및 6시간의 혈장 주성분으로 JTZ-951가 관찰되었고, 대사체로는 M2만 검출됨.
segments.en_txt: After repeated administration of JTZ-951 for 15 days to patients on maintenance hemodialysis, JTZ-951 was observed as the major plasma component at 1.5 and 6 hours, and only M2 was detected as a metabolite.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[2]
segments.ko_txt: M2는 거울상 이성질체((R)-M2 및 (S)-M2의 혼합물)이며, 그 비율((R)-M2: (S)-M2)은 15일간 반복 경구투여 후 1.5시간 및 6시간에는 각각 92.0:8.0 및 89.8:10.2였고, M2의 주성분은 (R)-M2임.
segments.en_txt: M2 is an enantiomeric isomer (a mixture of (R)-M2 and (S)-M2), and the ratio ((R)-M2: (S)-M2) at 1.5 hours and 6 hours after repeated oral administration for 15 days was 92.0:8.0 and 89.8:10.2, respectively, and the major component of M2 is (R)-M2.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[3]
segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951를 경구투여한 랫드의 경우 투여 후 48시간 내에 투여 방사능의 43.5%가 소변으로, 49.8%가 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: In rats administered 14C-JTZ-951 orally, 43.5% of the administered radioactivity was excreted in urine and 49.8% in feces within 48 hours post-dose.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[4]
segments.ko_txt: 개의 경우 투여 후 48시간 내에 투여 방사능의 8.2%가 소변으로, 84.9%가 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: In dogs, 8.2% of the administered radioactivity was excreted in urine and 84.9% in feces within 48 hours post-dose.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.1 in vivo 대사[5]
segments.ko_txt: 원숭이의 경우 투여 후 96시간 내에 투여 방사능의 23%가 소변으로, 68.9%가 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: In monkeys, 23% of the administered radioactivity was excreted in urine and 68.9% in feces within 96 hours post-dose.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.2 in vitro 대사[0]
segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951를 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 사람 마이크로솜과 배양시킨 후 대사체를 확인한 결과, 주성분 JTZ-951가 검출되었으며, 대사체로는 M1 또는 M2 또는 M6가 확인되었고, 이는 생체내 대사 결과와 약간 상이함(모화합물이 주로 검출되며, 대사체는 미미함).
segments.en_txt: After incubating 14C-JTZ-951 with microsomes from rat, dog, monkey, and human and identifying metabolites, the major component JTZ-951 was detected, and M1 or M2 or M6 was identified as a metabolite; this was slightly different from in vivo metabolic results (the parent compound was mainly detected and metabolites were minimal).

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.2 in vitro 대사[1]
segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951를 랫드, 개, 원숭이 및 사람 간세포와 배양시킨 후 대사체를 확인한 결과, 사람 및 랫드에서 M2, 원숭이에서 M3, M4, M5, M6가 미량 검출되었으나, 개에서는 전혀 대사되지 않음.
segments.en_txt: After incubating 14C-JTZ-951 with hepatocytes from rat, dog, monkey, and human and identifying metabolites, trace amounts of M2 were detected in human and rat and M3, M4, M5, and M6 were detected in monkey; however, no metabolism occurred in dog.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.4.3.2 in vitro 대사[2]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951 대사에 관여하는 CYP 효소를 탐색한 결과, JTZ-951는 CYP2C8, 2C9 및 3A4에 의해 대사되어 M2가 형성됨.
segments.en_txt: As a result of exploring CYP enzymes involved in JTZ-951 metabolism, JTZ-951 is metabolized by CYP2C8, 2C9, and 3A4 to form M2.

segments.ko_txt: 랫드, 개, 원숭이에 14C-JTZ-951를 경구투여한 후 방사능을 측정한 결과, 랫드의 경우 투여 후 168시간 내에 투여 방사능의 30.1% 및 64.3%가 소변 및 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: After oral administration of 14C-JTZ-951 to rats, dogs, and monkeys and measurement of radioactivity, in rats 30.1% and 64.3% of the administered radioactivity were excreted in urine and feces, respectively, within 168 hours post-dose.

segments.ko_txt: 개의 경우 168시간 내에 투여 방사능의 8.5% 및 87.6%가, 원숭이의 경우 45.6% 및 49.9%가 소변 및 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: In dogs, 8.5% and 87.6% of the administered radioactivity were excreted in urine and feces, respectively, within 168 hours, and in monkeys 45.6% and 49.9% were excreted in urine and feces, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: 담관루(bile duct fistula) 랫드에 14C-JTZ-951를 경구투여 후 48시간 내에 투여 방사능의 70.0%, 15.5% 및 10.7%가 각각 담즙, 소변 및 변으로 배설됨.
segments.en_txt: In bile duct fistula rats, after oral administration of 14C-JTZ-951, 70.0%, 15.5%, and 10.7% of the administered radioactivity were excreted in bile, urine, and feces, respectively, within 48 hours post-dose.

segments.ko_txt: 담관루(bile duct fistula) 랫드에 14C-JTZ-951를 경구투여 후 24시간 동안의 담즙을 랫드 십이지장 내 재투여하고 담즙, 소변 및 변의 방사능을 측정한 결과, 48시간 내에 투여 방사능의 53.9% 및 10.5%가 담즙 및 소변으로 배설됨을 확인함으로써 JTZ-951는 재흡수되는 것으로 사료됨.
segments.en_txt: In bile duct fistula rats, after oral administration of 14C-JTZ-951, bile collected for 24 hours was re-administered into the rat duodenum and radioactivity in bile, urine, and feces was measured; 53.9% and 10.5% of the administered radioactivity were excreted in bile and urine, respectively, within 48 hours, suggesting that JTZ-951 is reabsorbed.

segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg를 비금식 분만 후 10일째 되는 랫드에 투여한 결과, 방사능은 유즙으로 이행하여 투여 후 1시간 이후에는 모든 시점에서 혈장보다 높은 값을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: As a result of administering 14C-JTZ-951 1mg/kg to non-fasted rats on postpartum day 10, radioactivity was transferred into milk and showed higher values than plasma at all time points from 1 hour post-dose onward.

segments.ko_txt: 유즙 중 방사능의 AUCinf는 혈장의 약 7배로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: The AUCinf of radioactivity in milk was approximately 7 times that in plasma.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6 및 3A4/5의 활성을 저해하지 않았으며, JTZ-951 100μmol/L 첨가함으로써 CYP2B6, 2C8 및 2C9의 활성은 약간 저해되었고, 각각의 활성 잔존율은 75.3%, 54.4% 및 83.4%으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 did not inhibit the activity of CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A4/5; upon addition of JTZ-951 100μmol/L, the activities of CYP2B6, 2C8, and 2C9 were slightly inhibited, and the respective residual activities were 75.3%, 54.4%, and 83.4%.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 어떤 isozyme에서도 시간 의존적 저해를 나타내지 않음.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 did not show time-dependent inhibition for any isozyme.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 CYP1A2 및 3A4의 mRNA을 유도하지 않음.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 did not induce mRNA of CYP1A2 and 3A4.

segments.ko_txt: 수송체 기질 평가 결과, JTZ-951은 BCRP의 기질이며, MDR1의 기질은 아닌 것으로 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: Based on transporter substrate assessment, JTZ-951 is a substrate of BCRP and was observed not to be a substrate of MDR1.

segments.ko_txt: 신장에서 JTZ-951은 hOAT3, hOCT2, MATE1 및 MATE2-K 발현 세포에 대한 14C-JTZ-951의 흡수에서는 대조군 대비 뚜렷한 차이가 관찰되지 않아, JTZ-951은 hOAT3, hOCT2, MATE1 및 MATE2-K의 기질이 아닌 것으로 생각됨.
segments.en_txt: In the kidney, in the uptake of 14C-JTZ-951 into cells expressing hOAT3, hOCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K, no clear difference was observed versus the control group; therefore, JTZ-951 is considered not to be a substrate of hOAT3, hOCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K.

segments.ko_txt: 간에서 JTZ-951은 OATP1B1 및 OATP1B3 발현 세포에 대한 14C-JTZ-951의 흡수에서도 대조군 대비 뚜렷한 차이가 관찰되지 않아, JTZ-951은 OATP1B1 및 OATP1B3의 기질이 아닌 것으로 생각됨.
segments.en_txt: In the liver, in the uptake of 14C-JTZ-951 into cells expressing OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, no clear difference was observed versus the control group; therefore, JTZ-951 is considered not to be a substrate of OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

segments.ko_txt: 수송체 저해능 평가 결과, JTZ-951은 MDR1, hOCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K 및 OATP1B3에 대하여 저해작용을 나타내지 않았지만, BCRP, OATP1B1, hOAT1 및 hOAT3에 대하여 각각 43.2, 30.0, 0.956 및 1.67μmol/L의 IC50 값에서 저해작용을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: Based on transporter inhibition assessment, JTZ-951 did not show inhibitory effects on MDR1, hOCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, and OATP1B3, but showed inhibitory effects on BCRP, OATP1B1, hOAT1, and hOAT3 with IC50 values of 43.2, 30.0, 0.956, and 1.67μmol/L, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: 각종 혈액투석막에 의한 JTZ-951의 청소율을 평가하고자 사람 혈장에 JTZ-951를 첨가하고 투석을 실시한 결과(최대 120분), JTZ-951의 혈장 중 잔존율은 PS가 95.0%~97.0%, CTA는 98.5%~100%, PES는 94.9%~98.6%였음.
segments.en_txt: To evaluate the clearance of JTZ-951 by various hemodialysis membranes, JTZ-951 was added to human plasma and dialysis was performed (up to 120 minutes); the residual rate of JTZ-951 in plasma was 95.0%~97.0% for PS, 98.5%~100% for CTA, and 94.9%~98.6% for PES.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 혈장 중 농도는 투석 개시 시와 투석 종료 시에 거의 변함이 없었으며, JTZ-951의 투석청소율은 PS가 3.02%~5.03%, CTA는 0.361%~1.92%, PES는 3.02%~5.12%로 낮은 값을 나타냄으로써 어떤 막으로도 거의 제거되지 않음을 확인함.
segments.en_txt: The plasma concentration of JTZ-951 showed almost no change at the start and end of dialysis, and the dialysis clearance of JTZ-951 was low, at 3.02%~5.03% for PS, 0.361%~1.92% for CTA, and 3.02%~5.12% for PES, confirming that it is hardly removed by any membrane.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[0]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951 및 대사체 (R)-M2는 HIF-PH에 대해 최대 27nmol/L의 IC50 값을 가지며 두 화합물 모두 유사한 수준의 저해활성을 갖는 것으로 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 and the metabolite (R)-M2 have an IC50 value up to 27nmol/L against HIF-PH, and both compounds were observed to have similar levels of inhibitory activity.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[1]
segments.ko_txt: 생체 내에서 JTZ-951의 효과는 정상 및 신성빈혈 동물 모델을 대상으로 평가되었으며, 랫드 3mg/kg에서 EPO mRNA 발현 및 혈장 내 농도를 유의하게 증가시키는 것으로 관찰됨.
segments.en_txt: In vivo, the effects of JTZ-951 were evaluated in normal and renal anemia animal models, and at 3mg/kg in rats, EPO mRNA expression and plasma concentrations were observed to increase significantly.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[2]
segments.ko_txt: 랫드 3mg/kg 노출(Cmax 1.838μg/mL, AUC0-24 5.910μg·h/mL) 대비 신청 사람 최고 용량 1일 8mg 노출(Cmax 1.155μg/mL, AUC0-24 10.302μg·h/mL)은 Cmax 기준 63%, AUC 기준 174%에 해당되어 임상에서 JTZ-951의 효과가 발현될 것으로 예상됨.
segments.en_txt: Compared with rat 3mg/kg exposure (Cmax 1.838μg/mL, AUC0-24 5.910μg·h/mL), the exposure at the maximum proposed human dose of 8mg once daily (Cmax 1.155μg/mL, AUC0-24 10.302μg·h/mL) corresponds to 63% based on Cmax and 174% based on AUC, and thus clinical efficacy of JTZ-951 is expected to be expressed.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[3]
segments.ko_txt: 신성빈혈 동물 모델을 대상으로 적혈구 조혈에 대한 JTZ-951의 반복투여 효과를 평가한 결과, 1mg/kg부터 용량 의존적으로 Hb 농도를 유의하게 증가시키며, 철 매개변수 관련 평가에서도 활성 대조군 rHuEPO과 비교하여 철 이용능을 저하시키지 않으면서 적혈구 조혈 항진작용을 나타냄.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluating the repeated-dose effect of JTZ-951 on erythropoiesis in a renal anemia animal model, JTZ-951 significantly increased Hb concentration in a dose-dependent manner starting from 1mg/kg, and in evaluations related to iron parameters, it exhibited an erythropoiesis-stimulating effect without decreasing iron utilization capacity as compared with the active control rHuEPO.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[4]
segments.ko_txt: 안전성 약리시험에서 JTZ-951은 중추신경계(랫드 3, 10 및 30mg/kg) 및 호흡기계(개 1, 3 및 10mg/kg)에 영향을 미치지 않았으며, 심혈관계에 대한 검토에서 JTZ-951은 hERG 전류(10, 30 및 100μmol/L) 및 개(1, 3 및 10mg/kg)의 심전도에 영향을 미치지 않았음.
segments.en_txt: In safety pharmacology studies, JTZ-951 did not affect the central nervous system (rats 3, 10 and 30mg/kg) or respiratory system (dogs 1, 3 and 10mg/kg), and in the cardiovascular review, JTZ-951 did not affect hERG current (10, 30 and 100μmol/L) or electrocardiogram in dogs (1, 3 and 10mg/kg).

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[5]
segments.ko_txt: 다만 non-GLP 랫드를 이용한 심혈관계 평가에서 30mg/kg에서 일과성 수축기 혈압 저하 및 심박수 증가가 관찰되었으나, 랫드 30mg/kg 노출 기준 임상 8mg의 Cmax(1.1547μg/mL)는 43배의 안전역을 가짐으로써 임상에서의 안전성에 우려사항은 예상되지 않음.
segments.en_txt: However, in a cardiovascular evaluation in non-GLP rats, transient decreases in systolic blood pressure and increases in heart rate were observed at 30mg/kg; nevertheless, based on rat 30mg/kg exposure, the clinical Cmax (1.1547μg/mL) at 8mg has a 43-fold safety margin, and therefore no safety concerns are anticipated in clinical use.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[6]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 경구투여 생체이용률은 랫드, 개 및 원숭이에서 각각 74.5%, 39.4%, 41.7%를 나타내었으며, 원숭이의 경우 45.6% 및 49.9%가 각각 소변 및 변으로 배설되며, 식이영향 평가에서 금식군에서 약물의 노출이 상대적으로 높게 나타남.
segments.en_txt: The oral bioavailability of JTZ-951 was 74.5%, 39.4%, and 41.7% in rats, dogs, and monkeys, respectively; in monkeys, 45.6% and 49.9% were excreted in urine and feces, respectively, and in the food-effect evaluation, drug exposure was relatively higher in the fasted group.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[7]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 사람 혈장단백결합율은 99.5%로 높게 나타났으며, 혈구이행률은 낮고, 임신 및 수유 랫드를 이용한 분포시험에서 JTZ-951은 모유로 이동되며 태자의 조직 및 혈장에서 검출됨.
segments.en_txt: The plasma protein binding of JTZ-951 in humans was high at 99.5%; the blood cell partitioning was low; and in distribution studies using pregnant and lactating rats, JTZ-951 was transferred into milk and was detected in fetal tissues and plasma.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[8]
segments.ko_txt: 사람 간 마이크로솜을 이용한 대사효소 확인 시험에서 JTZ-951은 주로 CYP2C8, 2C9 및 3A4에 의해 대사되어 M2가 형성되는 것으로 나타남.
segments.en_txt: In a metabolic enzyme identification study using human liver microsomes, JTZ-951 was shown to be metabolized mainly by CYP2C8, 2C9, and 3A4 to form M2.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[9]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 BCRP의 기질이므로 BCRP 저해제 병용투여 시 약물상호작용 가능성이 있음.
segments.en_txt: As JTZ-951 is a substrate of BCRP, there is a potential for drug–drug interactions when co-administered with BCRP inhibitors.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[10]
segments.ko_txt: 따라서 BCRP 저해제와의 병용 시 이 약과의 상호작용 평가 여부가 임상에서 검토되어야 함.
segments.en_txt: Therefore, when co-administered with BCRP inhibitors, the need to evaluate interactions with this drug should be considered in clinical practice.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[11]
segments.ko_txt: 사용상의 주의사항 ‘상호작용’ 항에 BCRP 저해제 라파티닙과 병용 시 JTZ-951의 노출은 큰 영향을 받지 않는 것으로 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: In the “Drug Interactions” section of Precautions for Use, it was confirmed that exposure to JTZ-951 is not significantly affected when co-administered with the BCRP inhibitor lapatinib.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.5. 약리작용에 관한 자료.5.5. 약리에 대한 심사자 의견[12]
segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 hOAT1 및 hOAT3에 대하여 각각 0.956 및 1.67μmol/L의 IC50 값에서 저해작용을 나타내며, 해당 농도는 임상 최고 용량 8mg 노출(Cmax 1.155μg/mL) 범위에 포함되므로 OAT1 및 OAT3 기질과 병용 시 상호작용 가능성이 있을 것으로 판단됨.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 showed inhibitory effects on hOAT1 and hOAT3 at IC50 values of 0.956 and 1.67μmol/L, respectively; because these concentrations fall within the exposure range at the clinical maximum dose of 8mg (Cmax 1.155μg/mL), interactions are considered possible when co-administered with OAT1 and OAT3 substrates.

segments.ko_txt: 자료제출 증명서 제출(일본) • 가교시험 국내 임상시험 실시기관 수행 (임상정책과 실태조사 실시)
segments.en_txt: Submission of Certificate of Data Submission (Japan) • Bridging study conducted at a domestic clinical trial site (on-site inspection by the Clinical Trials Policy Division conducted)

segments.ko_txt: 임상시험성적자료 : 총22건(제1상 10건(일본2건, 미국8건), 제2a상 2건(일본), 2b상 3건(일본), 제3상 6건(일본), 국내가 교 1건)
segments.en_txt: Clinical study reports: total of 22 studies (Phase 1: 10 studies (2 in Japan, 8 in the U.S.), Phase 2a: 2 studies (Japan), Phase 2b: 3 studies (Japan), Phase 3: 6 studies (Japan), domestic bridging: 1 study)

segments.ko_txt: 시판 제형 - 1상에서는 나정, 2상이후에는 필름코팅정임. 후기 제2b 및 제3상에서 사용한 주요 조성과 시판제형 동일함. 식별을 위해 3 상시험 이후에 할선을 넣음.
segments.en_txt: Marketed formulation - In Phase 1, an uncoated tablet was used; from Phase 2 onward, a film-coated tablet was used. The main composition used in late Phase 2b and Phase 3 is identical to the marketed formulation. A score line was added after the Phase 3 trials for identification.

segments.ko_txt: PK 및 초기 내약성을 평가하기 위한 시험을 수행하였다.
segments.en_txt: A study was conducted to evaluate PK and initial tolerability.

segments.ko_txt: 1-200mg 단회 투여 시 Tmax(median)은 0.5-2.5시간, 반감기는 7.6-9.1시간으로 확인되었으며, 1-200mg 범위 내에서 용량 비례성이 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: After single doses of 1-200mg, the median Tmax was confirmed as 0.5-2.5 hours and the half-life as 7.6-9.1 hours, and dose proportionality was confirmed within the 1-200mg range.

segments.ko_txt: 식이 영향(Food effect) 평가 결과, 100mg 식후 투여 시 공복 투여 대비 AUC는 26% 감소하고, Cmax는 47% 감소하였다.
segments.en_txt: As a result of the food effect evaluation, when 100mg was administered after a meal, AUC decreased by 26% and Cmax decreased by 47% compared with administration in the fasted state.

segments.ko_txt: 요중 배설은 공복, 단회 투여 시 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: Urinary excretion was confirmed under fasting, single-dose conditions.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951을 1~100μg/mL의 농도 범위에서 사람의 혈장에 첨가했을 때 단백질 결합율은 99.1%~99.5%였다.
segments.en_txt: When JTZ-951 was spiked into human plasma at a concentration range of 1~100μg/mL, the protein binding was 99.1%~99.5%.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951을 1 및 10μg/mL의 농도 범위에서 4% 사람 혈장 중 알부민 및 0.07% α1-산성 당단백질에 첨가했을 때, 알부민에 대한 결합율이 더 높았으며, 알부민이 JTZ-951의 주요 결합 단백질로 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: When JTZ-951 was spiked into 4% human plasma at a concentration range of 1 and 10μg/mL with albumin and 0.07% α1-acid glycoprotein, binding to albumin was higher, and albumin was confirmed as the major binding protein for JTZ-951.

segments.ko_txt: 1~100μg/mL의 농도 범위 내에서 사람 혈구이행율은 2.5%~3.3%, 전혈/혈장 농도비는 0.56~0.57이었다.
segments.en_txt: Within the concentration range of 1~100μg/mL, the human blood cell partitioning was 2.5%~3.3%, and the whole blood/plasma concentration ratio was 0.56~0.57.

segments.ko_txt: 간 마이크로솜 내에서 JTZ-951의 대사는 미미했으며, 사람과 랫트에서 M2(벤질위의 수산화체)가 소량 생성되었고 M1(페닐에틸기의 벤젠핵 수산화체)도 검출되었다.
segments.en_txt: Metabolism of JTZ-951 in liver microsomes was minimal; small amounts of M2 (hydroxylated at the benzyl moiety) were formed in humans and rats, and M1 (hydroxylated on the benzene ring of the phenethyl group) was also detected.

segments.ko_txt: 원숭이에서는 소량의 M2 및 M6(N-카르보닐글리신부 이외의 산화체)가 생성되었으며, 개에서는 전혀 대사되지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: In monkeys, small amounts of M2 and M6 (an oxidized metabolite other than at the N-carbonylglycine moiety) were formed, whereas in dogs, no metabolism occurred.

segments.ko_txt: 간세포 내에서 JTZ-951의 대사는 미미했으며, 사람과 랫트에서 소량의 M2가 생성되었고, 사람에서는 M3(수산화체의 황산 접합체)도 소량 검출되었다.
segments.en_txt: Metabolism of JTZ-951 in hepatocytes was minimal; small amounts of M2 were formed in humans and rats, and in humans, small amounts of M3 (sulfate conjugate of the hydroxylated metabolite) were also detected.

segments.ko_txt: 원숭이에서는 M3, M4(글루코오스 접합체), M5(글루코오스 접합체), M6가 소량 생성되었으며, 개에서는 대사가 전혀 일어나지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: In monkeys, small amounts of M3, M4 (glucose conjugate), M5 (glucose conjugate), and M6 were formed, whereas in dogs, no metabolism occurred at all.

segments.ko_txt: 14C-JTZ-951는 CYP2C8, 2C9 및 3A4에 의해 대사되어 M2가 생성되었으며, CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1 및 3A5에서는 대사가 일어나지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: 14C-JTZ-951 was metabolized by CYP2C8, 2C9, and 3A4 to form M2, and no metabolism occurred via CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A5.

segments.ko_txt: CYP2C8 억제제 퀘르세틴, CYP2C9 억제제 설파페나졸, CYP3A4 억제제 케토코나졸에 의해 JTZ-951의 대사 및 M2 생성이 억제되었다.
segments.en_txt: Metabolism of JTZ-951 and formation of M2 were inhibited by the CYP2C8 inhibitor quercetin, the CYP2C9 inhibitor sulfaphenazole, and the CYP3A4 inhibitor ketoconazole.

segments.ko_txt: 따라서 JTZ-951의 산화적 대사에는 주로 CYP2C8 및 2C9가 기여하며, CYP3A4도 일부 관여하는 것으로 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: Therefore, CYP2C8 and 2C9 mainly contribute to the oxidative metabolism of JTZ-951, with CYP3A4 also involved to some extent.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 페닐에틸기의 벤젠핵 수산화로 M1, 벤질기의 수산화로 M2, M1 또는 M2의 황산 접합으로 M3, 글루코오스 접합으로 M4, 글루쿠론산 접합으로 M5, 그리고 원숭이에서 N-카르보닐글리신부 산화로 M6으로 대사된다.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 is metabolized to M1 via hydroxylation of the benzene ring of the phenethyl group, to M2 via hydroxylation of the benzyl group, to M3 via sulfate conjugation of M1 or M2, to M4 via glucose conjugation, to M5 via glucuronic acid conjugation, and in monkeys to M6 via oxidation of the N-carbonylglycine moiety.

segments.ko_txt: CYP 억제시험에서 JTZ-951은 CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6 및 3A4/5 활성을 억제하지 않았으며, 100μmol/L 농도에서 CYP2B6, 2C8, 2C9 활성을 각각 75.3%, 54.4%, 83.4% 수준으로 약간 억제하였다.
segments.en_txt: In CYP inhibition studies, JTZ-951 did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, or 3A4/5 activities, and at 100μmol/L it slightly inhibited CYP2B6, 2C8, and 2C9 activities to levels of 75.3%, 54.4%, and 83.4%, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 시간 의존적 억제를 나타내지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 did not show time-dependent inhibition.

segments.ko_txt: CYP 유도시험에서 JTZ-951은 농도 의존적으로 CYP1A2 및 3A4의 mRNA 발현을 감소시켰으며, 이는 HIF 안정화로 인한 약리작용에 기인한 것으로 보인다.
segments.en_txt: In CYP induction studies, JTZ-951 decreased CYP1A2 and 3A4 mRNA expression in a concentration-dependent manner, which appears to be attributable to its pharmacological action due to HIF stabilization.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951(0.1, 1, 10μg/mL)을 사람 혈장에 첨가하고 폴리설폰(PS), 셀룰로오스 트리아세테이트(CTA), 폴리에테르설폰(PES) 투석막을 이용해 120분간 투석한 결과, 혈장 중 잔존율은 PS 95.0%~97.0%, CTA 98.5%~100%, PES 94.9%~98.6%로 나타났다.
segments.en_txt: After adding JTZ-951 (0.1, 1, 10μg/mL) to human plasma and dialyzing for 120 minutes using polysulfone (PS), cellulose triacetate (CTA), and polyethersulfone (PES) dialysis membranes, the residual rates in plasma were PS 95.0%~97.0%, CTA 98.5%~100%, and PES 94.9%~98.6%.

segments.ko_txt: 투석 시작 및 종료 시 혈장 중 농도 변화가 거의 없었으며, JTZ-951은 어느 막에서도 거의 제거되지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: There was almost no change in plasma concentration at the start and end of dialysis, and JTZ-951 was hardly removed by any membrane.

segments.ko_txt: 건강한 성인에게 JTZ-951을 투여한 경우, 투여량의 26.79%~61.03%가 미변화체로 소변을 통해 배설되었다.
segments.en_txt: When JTZ-951 was administered to healthy adults, 26.79%~61.03% of the dose was excreted unchanged in urine.

segments.ko_txt: HD 환자에게 14C-JTZ-951을 투여한 Mass balance 시험 결과, 투여 방사능의 10.9%가 소변, 77.1%가 대변을 통해 배설되었다.
segments.en_txt: In a mass balance study in which 14C-JTZ-951 was administered to HD patients, 10.9% of the administered radioactivity was excreted in urine and 77.1% in feces.

segments.ko_txt: HD 환자에게 JTZ-951 15 mg을 단회 투여한 경우, JTZ-951의 AUCinf는 건강한 성인에 비해 약 1.7배 높았으며, 반감기(t1/2)는 건강한 성인(8.2시간)에 비해 HD 환자(11.3시간)에서 더 길었다.
segments.en_txt: After a single 15 mg dose of JTZ-951 in HD patients, AUCinf of JTZ-951 was approximately 1.7-fold higher than in healthy adults, and the half-life (t1/2) was longer in HD patients (11.3 hours) than in healthy adults (8.2 hours).

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 청소율(CL_F)은 건강한 성인(1.317 L/hr)에 비해 HD 환자(0.820 L/hr)에서 낮았으며, 이는 신장 기능 감소에 따른 청소율 저하가 HD 환자와 건강한 성인 간 약동학 차이의 주요 원인으로 보인다.
segments.en_txt: The clearance (CL_F) of JTZ-951 was lower in HD patients (0.820 L/hr) than in healthy adults (1.317 L/hr), and reduced clearance due to decreased renal function appears to be the main cause of the pharmacokinetic differences between HD patients and healthy adults.

segments.ko_txt: 병력, 성별, 체중은 PPK 분석에서 CL/F 및 V/F에 영향을 미치는 공변량으로 확인되었으나, 그 영향의 정도는 적어 임상적으로 유의한 차이는 없다고 판단된다.
segments.en_txt: Medical history, sex, and body weight were identified as covariates affecting CL/F and V/F in the PPK analysis; however, the magnitude of their effects was small, and no clinically meaningful differences are considered present.

segments.ko_txt: 연령(23~91세)은 PPK 분석 결과 유의미한 영향을 미치지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: Age (23~91 years) did not have a significant effect according to the PPK analysis results.

segments.ko_txt: 인종 간 비교 시, 일본인의 Cmax는 서양인과 유사하나 AUC는 약 1.6배 높았다.
segments.en_txt: In an interethnic comparison, Cmax in Japanese subjects was similar to that in Western subjects, but AUC was approximately 1.6-fold higher.

segments.ko_txt: 간기능장애 환자를 대상으로 한 임상약리시험은 수행되지 않았으며, 후기 제2상 및 제3상 임상시험에서는 중증 간질환 환자가 제외되었다.
segments.en_txt: No clinical pharmacology study was conducted in patients with hepatic impairment, and patients with severe liver disease were excluded from the late Phase 2 and Phase 3 clinical trials.

segments.ko_txt: PPK 분석 결과, ALT(3.0~75.0 IU/L), AST(2.0~79.0 U/L), γ-GTP(4.0~304.0 IU/L)의 범위 내에서 JTZ-951의 약동학에 대한 간기능검사치의 영향은 확인되지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: Based on the PPK analysis, no effect of liver function test values on the pharmacokinetics of JTZ-951 was identified within the ranges of ALT (3.0~75.0 IU/L), AST (2.0~79.0 U/L), and γ-GTP (4.0~304.0 IU/L).

segments.ko_txt: 100 mg 식후 경구 투여 시, 공복 투여와 비교하여 Tmax(공복 2.5시간, 식후 3.0시간) 및 t1/2(공복 8.4시간, 식후 7.8시간)의 차이는 없었으나, Cmax는 47%, AUCinf는 26% 감소하였다.
segments.en_txt: After oral administration of 100 mg after a meal, compared with administration in the fasted state, there were no differences in Tmax (fasted 2.5 hours, fed 3.0 hours) and t1/2 (fasted 8.4 hours, fed 7.8 hours), but Cmax decreased by 47% and AUCinf decreased by 26%.

segments.ko_txt: HD 환자를 대상으로 한 시험(AZ951-U-005)에서 JTZ-951 5 mg을 혈액 투석 시작 120분 전(Day1) 또는 종료 120분 후(Day8)에 단회 투여한 결과, Day1에서 투석 여과액 내 제거율은 6.74%에 불과하였다.
segments.en_txt: In a study in HD patients (AZ951-U-005), following a single dose of JTZ-951 5 mg administered 120 minutes before the start of hemodialysis (Day1) or 120 minutes after completion (Day8), the removal rate into dialysate on Day1 was only 6.74%.

segments.ko_txt: Day1과 Day8 간 혈장 농도 변화가 없어, 혈액 투석이 JTZ-951의 약동학에 미치는 영향은 거의 없는 것으로 판단되었다.
segments.en_txt: As there was no change in plasma concentrations between Day1 and Day8, hemodialysis was considered to have little effect on the pharmacokinetics of JTZ-951.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 PS, CTA, PES 투석막에서 거의 제거되지 않았다(비공개 데이터).
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 was hardly removed by PS, CTA, and PES dialysis membranes (unpublished data).

segments.ko_txt: CYP 효소를 억제 또는 유도하는 약물과 병용 시 JTZ-951의 약동학에 미치는 영향은 낮을 것으로 평가되었다.
segments.en_txt: The impact on the pharmacokinetics of JTZ-951 when co-administered with drugs that inhibit or induce CYP enzymes was assessed to be low.

segments.ko_txt: CKD 환자(HD, PD, 보존기 CKD)에서는 신장이 JTZ-951의 배출에 미치는 영향이 적어, hOAT1 억제에 의한 약동학 변화 가능성도 낮다.
segments.en_txt: In CKD patients (HD, PD, conservative-stage CKD), the kidney has little effect on the elimination of JTZ-951; therefore, the potential for pharmacokinetic changes due to hOAT1 inhibition is also low.

segments.ko_txt: BCRP 억제제 라파티닙 병용 시 JTZ-951의 Cmax는 28.5%, AUCinf는 32.1%로 미미하게 증가하였다.
segments.en_txt: When co-administered with the BCRP inhibitor lapatinib, Cmax and AUCinf of JTZ-951 increased slightly by 28.5% and 32.1%, respectively.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951 단독 투여 대비 세벨라머탄산염 동시 투여 시 Cmax는 53%, AUCinf는 45% 감소하였으며, 세벨라머탄산염 투여 1시간 전 또는 3시간 후 투여 시 JTZ-951의 Cmax 및 AUCinf의 기하 평균 비율은 0.80~0.94였다.
segments.en_txt: Compared with administration of JTZ-951 alone, concomitant administration with sevelamer carbonate decreased Cmax by 53% and AUCinf by 45%; when sevelamer carbonate was administered 1 hour before or 3 hours after dosing, the geometric mean ratios of Cmax and AUCinf of JTZ-951 were 0.80~0.94.

segments.ko_txt: 이에 따라 JTZ-951과 세벨라머탄산염은 투여 간격을 두고 병용하도록 권고된다.
segments.en_txt: Accordingly, it is recommended that JTZ-951 and sevelamer carbonate be co-administered with a dosing interval.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951은 CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 및 3A4/5를 억제하거나 약물상호작용을 일으킬 가능성이 낮다.
segments.en_txt: JTZ-951 is unlikely to inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A4/5 or to cause drug–drug interactions.

segments.ko_txt: 또한 BCRP, OATP1B1, hOAT1 등의 수송체 단백질을 억제하여 약물상호작용을 유발할 가능성도 낮다.
segments.en_txt: In addition, it is also unlikely to cause drug–drug interactions by inhibiting transporter proteins such as BCRP, OATP1B1, and hOAT1.

segments.ko_txt: 집단 약동학시험은 해당 없음.
segments.en_txt: Population pharmacokinetic study: not applicable.

segments.ko_txt: QT/QTc 평가시험에서 건강한 성인 남녀에게 20 mg, 150 mg, 목시플록사신 400 mg, 위약을 단회 투여한 결과, 심실 재분극 및 기타 심전도 지표에 영향을 미치지 않았다.
segments.en_txt: In a QT/QTc evaluation study, after single administration of 20 mg, 150 mg, moxifloxacin 400 mg, and placebo to healthy adult males and females, no effects on ventricular repolarization or other ECG parameters were observed.

segments.ko_txt: 약력학적 작용 평가에서 JTZ-951 투여군의 EPO는 모든 용량군에서 증가하였으며, 투여 8시간 후 Emax에 도달하였다.
segments.en_txt: In the pharmacodynamic effect assessment, EPO increased in the JTZ-951 treatment group across all dose groups and reached Emax at 8 hours after dosing.

segments.ko_txt: EPO는 Emax 도달 후 25 mg군에서는 Day8(투여 종료 24시간 후), 50 mg군에서는 Day9(투여 종료 48시간 후)에 Day1 투여 전 수준으로 회복되었다.
segments.en_txt: After reaching Emax, EPO returned to the pre-dose level on Day8 (24 hours after the end of dosing) in the 25 mg group and on Day9 (48 hours after the end of dosing) in the 50 mg group.

segments.ko_txt: EPO의 Emax 및 AUCtau는 투여량 비례 이상으로 증가하였다.
segments.en_txt: Emax and AUCtau of EPO increased more than dose proportionally.

segments.ko_txt: JTZ-951의 핵심 임상시험은 총 9건으로, 제2b상 3건, 제3상 6건(이 중 국내 가교 3상 1건 포함)으로 구성되었다.
segments.en_txt: A total of 9 pivotal clinical studies of JTZ-951 were conducted, consisting of 3 Phase 2b studies and 6 Phase 3 studies (including 1 domestic bridging Phase 3 study).

segments.ko_txt: 이들 9건의 임상시험(모두 일본에서 수행)은 초기투여기(4~6주)에서의 Hb 증가(빈혈 개선) 효과, ESA에서 전환 후 Hb 유지 효과(전환 효과), 그리고 Hb 농도에 따라 투여량을 조절한 유지투여기(24~52주)의 Hb 유지 효과(유지 효과)를 평가하였다.
segments.en_txt: These 9 clinical trials (all conducted in Japan) evaluated the effect of Hb increase (anemia improvement) during the initial dosing period (4~6 weeks), the effect of maintaining Hb after switching from ESA (switching effect), and the effect of maintaining Hb during the maintenance dosing period (24~52 weeks) with dose adjustment according to Hb concentration (maintenance effect).

Hb 변화량 (용량 반응 및 유지 효과)

Part1: JTZ-951의 용량 증가에 따라 Hb 농도 상승 확인. Hb 10~12 g/dL 달성률은 2mg 투여군 대비 4mg, 6mg군에서 높았음. Part2: 전체 대상자 평균 Hb 농도 Week 60 시점 10.14 g/dL (95% CI 9.85–10.43), EOT 10.49 g/dL (95% CI 10.24–10.74). 지속투여 시 Hb 10–12 g/dL 유지.
평균 JTZ-951 투여량 Week 20~24 기준 4.26 mg/일, 다베포에틴 알파 대조군 16.9 μg/주. 전체 기간 평균 Hb 안정적 유지. VEGF 등 추가적 변화 없음.
5% 이상 발생 이상반응: JTZ-951 투여군 바이러스 성기 감염 32.2%, 구토 10.3%, 인플루엔자 9.2%, 통증 6.8%. 중대한 이상반응은 4.8%에서 보고됨.
Hb 농도 상승속도: 0.5 g/dL/week, 평균 Hb Week 24 기준 9.64 g/dL (95% CI 8.71–9.91). Hb 10–12 g/dL 도달률 75.8%. 이상반응: 단발 열창상 14.7%, 바이러스 성기감염 14.7%.
평균 Hb Week 52 기준 10.63 g/dL (95% CI 10.51–10.74), 종료 시점 10.72 g/dL (95% CI 10.56–10.88). PPS 기준 Hb 10–12 g/dL 도달률 81.7%. 10% 이상 이상반응: 바이러스 성기감염 49.3%, 단백뇨 12.5%.

en_txt.제목: Summary of key clinical trial results (including hemodialysis, PD, and CKD groups)
행: HD patients (hemodialysis patients on maintenance therapy for renal anemia)
Initial dosing period 6 weeks, maintenance dosing period 24 weeks
Change in Hb (dose–response and maintenance effect)

Part 1: An increase in Hb concentration was confirmed with dose escalation of JTZ-951. The achievement rate of Hb 10–12 g/dL was higher in the 4 mg and 6 mg groups than in the 2 mg group. Part 2: The mean Hb concentration in all subjects was 10.14 g/dL at Week 60 (95% CI 9.85–10.43) and 10.49 g/dL at EOT (95% CI 10.24–10.74). With continued administration, Hb 10–12 g/dL was maintained.

The mean JTZ-951 dose was 4.26 mg/day during Weeks 20–24; the darbepoetin alfa control group received 16.9 μg/week. Mean Hb was stably maintained throughout the entire period. No additional changes such as VEGF were observed.
Adverse reactions occurring in ≥5%: viral genital infection 32.2%, vomiting 10.3%, influenza 9.2%, pain 6.8% in the JTZ-951 group. Serious adverse reactions were reported in 4.8%.
Rate of Hb increase and maintenance effect

Rate of increase in Hb concentration: 0.5 g/dL/week; mean Hb at Week 24 was 9.64 g/dL (95% CI 8.71–9.91). The attainment rate of Hb 10–12 g/dL was 75.8%. Adverse reactions: single thermal burn injury 14.7%, viral genital infection 14.7%.

Mean Hb at Week 52 was 10.63 g/dL (95% CI 10.51–10.74) and 10.72 g/dL at end of study (95% CI 10.56–10.88). Based on the PPS, the attainment rate of Hb 10–12 g/dL was 81.7%. Adverse reactions ≥10%: viral genital infection 49.3%, proteinuria 12.5%.

segments.ko_txt: 6.5.7 유효성 결과 요약 및 결론: 에나로두스타트는 활성대조군(다베포에틴 알파) 대비 평균 Hb 농도에서 비열등성을 입증하였다.
segments.en_txt: 6.5.7 Summary and conclusion of efficacy results: Enarodustat demonstrated non-inferiority in mean Hb concentration compared with the active control (darbepoetin alfa).

segments.ko_txt: 초기용량(NDD 및 PD-CKD 환자 2mg, HD-CKD 환자 4mg)에서 기존 ESA 치료 여부나 용량에 영향을 받지 않고 빈혈 개선 효과를 나타냈다.
segments.en_txt: At the initial dose (2 mg for NDD and PD-CKD patients, 4 mg for HD-CKD patients), it showed an anemia improvement effect regardless of prior ESA treatment status or dose.

segments.ko_txt: 유지용량 1~8mg 범위 내에서 평가기간 중 목표 Hb 범위(10~12 g/dL)를 안정적으로 유지함으로써 유효성이 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: Efficacy was confirmed by stably maintaining the target Hb range (10–12 g/dL) during the evaluation period within the maintenance dose range of 1–8 mg.

segments.ko_txt: 6.5.8 안전성 결과 요약 및 결론: 통합분석 결과, 에나로두스타트의 가장 흔한 이상반응(≥5%)은 비인두염 등 감염, 위장관 장애(변비, 설사, 구토), 고혈압, 타박상이었다.
segments.en_txt: 6.5.8 Summary and conclusion of safety results: In the integrated analysis, the most common adverse reactions (≥5%) to enarodustat were infections such as nasopharyngitis, gastrointestinal disorders (constipation, diarrhea, vomiting), hypertension, and contusions.

segments.ko_txt: 기타 흔한 이상반응(≥2%)으로 단락 협착, 단락 폐색, 섬유소 D-이량체 증가, 고칼륨혈증, 어지러움 등이 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: Other common adverse reactions (≥2%) included shunt stenosis, shunt occlusion, increased fibrin D-dimer, hyperkalemia, and dizziness.

segments.ko_txt: 주요 약물이상반응(≥0.1%)은 눈 장애(망막 출혈, 황반부종), 위장장애, 부종, 고혈압, 심부정맥 혈전증 등이었다.
segments.en_txt: Major adverse drug reactions (≥0.1%) included eye disorders (retinal hemorrhage, macular edema), gastrointestinal disorders, edema, hypertension, and deep vein thrombosis.

segments.ko_txt: 중증 약물이상반응으로는 사망 1건(8mg 투여 시 혈압 상승 및 말초부종), 폐색전증, 인플루엔자 폐렴, 경막하 혈종, 형질세포성 골수종, 시상 출혈, 만성 신장병 등이 있었다.
segments.en_txt: Severe adverse drug reactions included 1 death (increased blood pressure and peripheral edema during 8 mg administration), pulmonary embolism, influenza pneumonia, subdural hematoma, plasma cell myeloma, thalamic hemorrhage, and chronic kidney disease.

segments.ko_txt: 9건의 임상시험 통합 분석에서 혈전색전 및 경색 관련 이상반응은 8.6%, 약물이상반응은 0.8%로 확인되었다.
segments.en_txt: In an integrated analysis of 9 clinical trials, thromboembolic- and infarction-related adverse reactions were identified as 8.6%, and adverse drug reactions as 0.8%.

segments.ko_txt: 6.5.9 유익성-위해성 평가 (CTD 2.5.6): 유익성 측면에서 에나로두스타트는 투석 의존 및 비의존 만성 신질환 환자 모두에서 Hb를 목표 수준으로 상승 및 유지시켰으며, 경구제로서 주사형 ESA와 동등한 유효성을 보였다.
segments.en_txt: 6.5.9 Benefit–risk assessment (CTD 2.5.6): From the benefit perspective, enarodustat increased and maintained Hb to target levels in both dialysis-dependent and non-dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease patients, and as an oral agent showed efficacy equivalent to injectable ESA.

segments.ko_txt: 저산소 반응 유도에 따른 내인성 EPO 생성 촉진을 통해 새로운 조혈 기전을 가진 치료제로 평가된다.
segments.en_txt: It is assessed as a therapeutic agent with a new erythropoietic mechanism through promotion of endogenous EPO production via induction of the hypoxic response.

segments.ko_txt: ESA 반응성이 낮은 환자에서도 효과를 기대할 수 있으며, EPO 교차반응 항체로 인한 부작용 위험을 줄인다.
segments.en_txt: Efficacy can be expected even in patients with low ESA responsiveness, and it reduces the risk of adverse effects due to EPO cross-reactive antibodies.

segments.ko_txt: 경구 제형으로 주사 치료가 어려운 환자에게 치료 선택의 폭을 넓힌다.
segments.en_txt: As an oral formulation, it broadens treatment options for patients for whom injection therapy is difficult.

segments.ko_txt: 위해성 측면에서는 적혈구 조혈 촉진에 따른 혈액 점도 증가로 혈전색전증 위험이 있으며, 심혈관계 안전성에 대한 우려가 존재한다.
segments.en_txt: From the risk perspective, there is a risk of thromboembolism due to increased blood viscosity associated with stimulation of erythropoiesis, and concerns regarding cardiovascular safety exist.

segments.ko_txt: HIF-PH 억제제 기전상 VEGF 관련 부가 약리작용으로 특정 질환 위험 증가 가능성이 있다.
segments.en_txt: Based on the mechanism of HIF-PH inhibitors, there is a possibility of increased risk of certain diseases due to additional VEGF-related pharmacologic effects.

segments.ko_txt: 또한 경구 제형 특성상 대사 및 흡수 과정에서 주사제 대비 추가적인 부작용이 발생할 수 있다.
segments.en_txt: In addition, due to the characteristics of the oral formulation, additional adverse effects may occur during metabolism and absorption compared with injectable formulations.

segments.ko_txt: 전반적으로 혈액 투석환자에서는 정기적 모니터링을 통해 Hb 수치 및 혈전 위험을 관리할 수 있으며, 활성대조군(다베포에틴 알파) 대비 Hb 농도에서 비열등성이 입증되어 ESA 불응성 빈혈 환자 치료제로서 임상적 이익이 인정된다.
segments.en_txt: Overall, in hemodialysis patients, Hb levels and thrombotic risk can be managed through regular monitoring, and non-inferiority in Hb concentration versus the active control (darbepoetin alfa) was demonstrated; therefore, the clinical benefit is recognized as a treatment for ESA-refractory anemia patients.

segments.ko_txt: 한국인을 대상으로 실시한 안전성․유효성 확증시험 자료 1건(JWP-JTZ-301 Study) 제출하였음.
segments.en_txt: One confirmatory study dataset on safety and efficacy conducted in Koreans (JWP-JTZ-301 Study) was submitted.

segments.en_txt: When evaluated by each assessment item of “drug sensitivity to ethnic factors” presented in the ICH E5 guideline, JTZ-951 was confirmed to be a drug that does not show differences according to ethnic factors, i.e., a drug with low ethnic sensitivity (less likely ethnically insensitive).

en_txt.제목: Table 14. Summary of JTZ-951 risk factor assessment
행: Related to linear pharmacokinetics of JTZ-951 at doses between 1–200 mg
Hemoglobin (Hb): Blood Hb concentration and target attainment rate increase in a dose-dependent manner with JTZ-951

At JTZ-951 50–400 mg, Cmax and AUCinf increase dose-proportionally, and there is no exposure accumulation upon repeated dosing. Based on the maximum tolerated dose of 8 mg, the safety range is maintained from 50μM to 400mM.

Based on in vitro test results using human CYP expression system enzymes, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9 are mainly involved in oxidative metabolism, with some contribution from CYP3A4. Metabolite M2 was identified as the major product.
Human plasma protein binding is 99.1%–99.5%; the main binding protein is albumin, and binding to α1-acid glycoprotein is low. A saturation tendency was observed at high concentrations (>100μg/mL).
The potential for CYP inhibition and induction is low. When co-administered with a BCRP inhibitor, JTZ-951 Cmax increased by 28.5% and AUCinf by 32.1%. There is potential inhibition of OAT1 and OAT3.
It induces EPO expression through HIF-PHD inhibition and exerts systemic effects.
As a prescription drug, it must be used under physician supervision.
High potential for concomitant administration with other drugs

segments.ko_txt: 한국인을 대상으로 실시한 임상시험(JWP-JTZ-301 Study)은 일본에서 실시된 3상 임상시험 중 혈액투석 환자를 대상으로 한 MBA4-5 시험을 참고하여 진행하였으며, 가교 자료로서 두 임상시험자료를 비교하여 평가하였음.
segments.en_txt: The clinical trial conducted in Koreans (JWP-JTZ-301 Study) was conducted with reference to the MBA4-5 trial among the Phase 3 clinical trials conducted in Japan in hemodialysis patients, and as bridging data, the two clinical trial datasets were compared and evaluated.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[0]
segments.ko_txt: 약물의 민족간 차이를 평가하기 위한 예측지표로서, ICH E5 부록 D에 따라 약물의 민족적 감수성을 평가하였을 때, 민족적 감수성은 작을 것으로 판단됨.
segments.en_txt: As a predictive indicator to evaluate inter-ethnic differences of the drug, when ethnic sensitivity was assessed in accordance with ICH E5 Appendix D, ethnic sensitivity is considered to be low.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[1]
segments.ko_txt: 가교자료 생성을 위한 국내 임상시험은 원개발사의 치료적 확증시험과 동일한 디자인으로 진행되었으며, 이때 임상시험에 적용된 의료형태는 실제 일본 및 한국에서 만성신장질환 관련 빈혈(신성빈혈) 환자의 치료를 위해 적용되는 행태와 유사하였다.
segments.en_txt: The domestic clinical trial for generation of bridging data was conducted with the same design as the originator’s therapeutic confirmatory trial, and the medical practice pattern applied in the clinical trial was similar to the practice applied in Japan and Korea for the treatment of patients with anemia associated with chronic kidney disease (renal anemia).

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[2]
segments.ko_txt: 즉, CKD 진단기준, 신성빈혈 치료에 사용되는 병용약물, 보조치료의 유형 등이 나라 간에 매우 유사하였다.
segments.en_txt: That is, the CKD diagnostic criteria, concomitant medications used for renal anemia treatment, and types of supportive therapy were very similar between countries.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[3]
segments.ko_txt: 유효성 평가변수에 대한 평가 결과, 일차 유효성 평가변수였던 “베이스라인 대비 평가기간의 평균 Hb 농도 변화량” 및 “평가기간의 평균 Hb 농도 차이”에 있어서 그 차이가 모 시험(일본, MBA4-5 시험)과 가교 시험(한국, JWP-JTZ-301 시험) 간에 통계적으로 유의한 차이를 보이지 않는 것으로 나타났다.
segments.en_txt: As a result of evaluation of the efficacy endpoints, for the primary efficacy endpoints, “change in mean Hb concentration from baseline during the evaluation period” and “difference in mean Hb concentration during the evaluation period,” the differences between the parent trial (Japan, MBA4-5 trial) and the bridging trial (Korea, JWP-JTZ-301 trial) were shown not to be statistically significant.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[4]
segments.ko_txt: 또한, 여러 이차 유효성 평가변수에 대한 두 시험간 비교에서 24주까지의 Hb와 관련된 여러가지 평가변수 및 임상시험용 의약품의 용량 조절 횟수 등에 있어서 유사한 경향의 결과를 나타냈다.
segments.en_txt: In addition, in comparisons between the two trials for various secondary efficacy endpoints, similar trends were shown in various Hb-related endpoints up to Week 24 and in the number of dose adjustments of the investigational medicinal product.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[5]
segments.ko_txt: 결론적으로 JTZ-951은 만성신장질환 관련 빈혈 환자에 있어서 한국인과 일본인에게서 유사한 개선 효과를 보였으므로, 유효성 결과에 대한 일본인과 한국인의 인종간의 차이는 없는 것으로 판단됨.
segments.en_txt: In conclusion, because JTZ-951 showed similar improvement effects in Koreans and Japanese patients with anemia associated with chronic kidney disease, it is considered that there are no racial differences between Japanese and Koreans with respect to efficacy results.

segments.path: $[2].붙임.붙임1_안전성유효성심사결과.6. 임상시험성적에 관한 자료.6.6.가교자료.6.6.4. 가교평가에 대한 심사자의견[6]
segments.ko_txt: 한국인을 대상으로 실시한 임상시험에서 보고된 이상반응은 시험군과 대조군간 유사하였으며, 일본인을 대상으로 실시된 핵심임상시험의 안전성 결과와 비교하여, 특이적인 이상사례가 발생하지 않았으며, 이상사례 발생률은 유사하였으므로, 안전성에서 한국인과 비한국인간의 임상적 유의한 차이는 없는 것으로 판단됨.
segments.en_txt: Adverse reactions reported in the clinical trial conducted in Koreans were similar between the investigational group and the control group; compared with the safety results of the pivotal clinical trials conducted in Japanese subjects, no specific adverse events occurred and the incidence of adverse events was similar; therefore, it is considered that there are no clinically meaningful differences in safety between Koreans and non-Koreans.

segments.ko_txt: 안전성 측면에서, 약물 약리기전 상 나타날 수 있는 이상반응이 임상시험 결과에서 확인됨.
segments.en_txt: From a safety perspective, adverse reactions that may occur based on the drug’s pharmacological mechanism of action were confirmed in the clinical trial results.

segments.ko_txt: 혈액 투석환자에서의 에나로두스타트 치료는 정기적인 모니터링을 통하여 Hb 수치 및 혈전 등의 위험 관리가 필요함.
segments.en_txt: Treatment with enarodustat in hemodialysis patients requires risk management for Hb levels and thrombosis, etc., through regular monitoring.

segments.ko_txt: 1년 이상 장기적으로 투여된 임상 정보가 부족하므로 위해성관리계획(RMP)을 통하여 지속적으로 이상반응 모니터링 및 안전성 평가 필요함.
segments.en_txt: As clinical information on long-term administration for 1 year or longer is insufficient, continuous monitoring of adverse reactions and safety evaluation through the Risk Management Plan (RMP) are required.

segments.ko_txt: 유효성 측면에서 활성대조군(다베포에틴알파) 대비 Hb 농도에서 비열등성을 입증하였으므로, 적혈구 생성 촉진제(ESA)에 불응성인 환자의 빈혈 치료제로서의 임상적 이익이 있을 것으로 사료됨.
segments.en_txt: From an efficacy perspective, non-inferiority in Hb concentration compared with the active control (darbepoetin alfa) was demonstrated; therefore, it is considered that there will be clinical benefit as a treatment for anemia in patients who are hyporesponsive to erythropoiesis-stimulating agents (ESAs).
